description: Saskatoon Police hired 15 new recruits for July class.
New recruits include visible minority, Indigenous, and female officers.
Police plan to assign nine officers to transit policing by 2027.

chips.text: Chief engaged with 8th Street Corridor businesses and Fairhaven residents.
Police did not provide current strength numbers relative to authorized staffing levels.
Chief committed to prioritizing exemplary recruits and finding space, even over strength.

description: Police Truth, Reconciliation, Treaty Implementation project is 81% complete.
Long-serving officers and new recruits receive five-day Indigenous training.
New Indigenous training module planned for police promotion exams.

chips.text: Constable Shayna Lyndon developed the Indigenous training curriculum, now used by police colleges.
No specific recruitment target percentage for Indigenous members has been set yet.
Police will embed Indigenous-inspired displays within headquarters in public and secure areas.

speakers.name: Inspector Doug McNeil
speakers.summary: Inspector Doug McNeil presented the report.
said: TRTI Champions Committee established, increasing implementation progress from 60% to 81%.
Expanded Indigenous training for officers, leadership, and collaborated with OTC.
Hosted and participated in numerous Indigenous community events and initiatives.
